description: Minecraft: Java Edition via Prism Launcher. Starts straight into the launcher with GPU rendering through VirtualGL. Game files download on first launch; requires a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition.
notes: For GPU rendering set GPU count 1, Graphics Acceleration EGL and Video Encoding NVENC on the workspace (needs VirtualGL 3.1.5+, included). Set a Persistent Profile Path such as /mnt/kasm_profiles/{username}/{image_id} to keep your sign-in and worlds. Source and details: https://github.com/rchurro/kasm-minecraft
